rows.contract: A screenshot request sets one destination, layout and callback. Completion callback receives the orientation once the renderer owns copied pixels.
rows.native_mapping: Retain the shared single-request policy and serialize request publishers; native renderer continues holding the flag through completion.
rows.expected_result: Concurrent producers are admitted one at a time with self-consistent destination/layout and callback. Pending native pixel verification stays with 091.
rows.actual_result: Native and feature-off compile, 1024 real concurrent screenshot publish pairs, final native/Qt link and regression baseline passed.
